title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on the development of students' cross-cultural communication abilities. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: In an era of deepening globalization, the ability to communicate across cultures has become indispensable. I firmly believe that universities should attach great importance to developing students' cross-cultural communication abilities. For one thing, such competence helps reduce misunderstandings rooted in different customs and values, making cooperation smoother. For instance, when I joined an international online project, teammates from three countries reached agreement quickly only because we respected each other's communication styles. For another, in today's competitive job market, graduates who can embrace diversity and work with global partners clearly stand out. Therefore, we students should seize every chance to broaden our horizons, such as joining exchange programs, reading foreign works, or making friends with international students. Only by becoming true global citizens can we thrive in a connected world.
keyPoints: 背景加立场一步到位。首段两句落实了『背景引出观点』：第一句 In an era of deepening globalization... has become indispensable 用背景句引题，第二句 I firmly believe that universities should attach great importance... 直接亮立场，开门见山、切题明确。
点理例结撑实主体。主体段用 For one thing / For another 串起两条理由，第一条后接 For instance, when I joined an international online project... 这个大学生亲历小例把道理坐实，正是『点 —理—例—结』的落地，避免了空喊口号。
行动加倒装收束。结尾用 Therefore, we students should seize every chance... 把论证收成 具体做法，再用倒装句 Only by becoming true global citizens can we thrive... 升华，呼应立场又不重 复原话。
